patch_description: The softmin/softmax surrogate in `_neg_obj` only approaches the true objective as beta→∞, so L-BFGS-B converges to borderline plateaus just below the true optimum (min_max_ratio 0.21 vs the ~0.24 reference). The decisive improvement is to add a hard-constrained SLSQP stage that directly maximizes t subject to d_ij² ≥ t and d_ij² ≤ 1 (all pairwise distances simultaneously bounded, which is *exactly* the min-max ratio problem). SLSQP handles analytic constraint Jacobians, so this is cheap for 14 points (91 pairs, 43 variables). We then apply escalating-tolerance passes with small perturbation restarts (as recommended), always keeping the better configuration, so every pass is risk-free.
